system_configurations.name: RCCL-MI350P-PCIe-8GPU-Func
system_configurations.description: Single-node 8x MI350P PCIe switch. Correctness sweep of {Simple,LL} x {IPC,SHM} x {Ring,Tree} x channel counts 1,2,4,8,16,32,64. SHM sets NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1. IPC sets NCCL_SHM_DISABLE=1. Requires 8 GPUs; the topology unit test does not.

tests.name: Mi350pPcieTopo_EightGfx950GpusNoXgmi
tests.description: CPU-only load of topo_8p_950_pcie.xml. Checks 8 gfx950 GPUs, device 0x75a8, PEX890 switches, and no XGMI paths.
